inclusion_criteria.rationale: In official geographical categorizations by Nepal's Central Bureau of Statistics / National Statistics Office (NSO) and Department of Hydrology & Meteorology (DHM), the Terai Lowland Ecological Belt strictly comprises 18 Outer Terai districts extending continuously across the southern plains. Valleys enclosed between the Mahabharat and Chure/Siwalik ranges (Chitwan, Dang, Nawalpur) constitute the Inner Terai (Bhitri Madhesh) and are cataloged under inner_terai to prevent geographical confusion.
